title: Constrain a sketch
intro: Lines snap and constraints appear as you draw; dimensions drive the geometry; drag a point and the solver keeps every rule. Then the agent cuts the sketch into the part.

steps.narr: The mounting plate. We will draw a small rectangular pocket outline by hand and pin it down with constraints before the agent cuts it.
Click the plate's top face and press K. With the Line tool, click four corners and click the first point again to close. Eight degrees of freedom: four free points.
Drawing added constraints for you: each segment that came out level or plumb got a Horizontal or Vertical rule (the H and V glyphs). Four degrees of freedom left: position and size.

Switch to Select (V), click the top edge, press D and type 12; click the left edge, D, 8. The geometry moves to match the numbers, not the other way round. Two degrees of freedom left: where the rectangle sits.
Drag a corner: the whole rectangle follows, still 12 × 8, still square. A constraint that conflicts with the others, or one already implied by them, is refused with a message.
Finish writes the sketch and its constraints into the script as a block. It shows as a cyan outline and is listed under Sketches in the Browser; reopen it any time.

steps.text:
# sketch:pocket {"plane":{"origin":[0,0,4],"x_dir":[1,0,0],"z_dir":[0,0,1],"label":"Plate top"},"items":[{"type":"profile","start":[-25.0,-1.0],"segs":[{"to":[-13.0,-1.0]},{"to":[-13.0,7.0]},{"to":[-25.0,7.0]},{"to":[-25.0,-1.0]}],"mode":"add"}],"constraints":[{"type":"horizontal","refs":[{"i":0,"e":0}]},{"type":"vertical","refs":[{"i":0,"e":1}]},{"type":"horizontal","refs":[{"i":0,"e":2}]},{"type":"vertical","refs":[{"i":0,"e":3}]},{"type":"length","refs":[{"i":0,"e":0}],"value":12},{"type":"length","refs":[{"i":0,"e":1}],"value":8}]}
with BuildSketch(Plane(origin=(0, 0, 4), x_dir=(1, 0, 0), z_dir=(0, 0, 1))) as _pocket:
    with BuildLine():
        Line((-25, -1), (-13, -1))
        Line((-13, -1), (-13, 7))
        Line((-13, 7), (-25, 7))
        Line((-25, 7), (-25, -1))
    make_face()
pocket = _pocket.sketch
# /sketch:pocket
steps.narr: The block: ordinary build123d lines, and the JSON header carries the constraints so the editor (and the agent's sketch tool) can pick them up again.

steps.text: Cut the pocket sketch 3 mm into the plate.
steps.narr: Ask the agent to use it. The sketch travels as a chip.

steps.narr: pocket is a normal build123d Sketch variable, so the agent subtracts a 3 mm extrusion of it from the plate.
A 12 × 8 pocket, 3 mm deep, exactly where you dragged it. Change a dimension in the sketch and the pocket follows.
